asctb.table: Anatomical Structures, Cell Types and Biomarkers Table for Pancreas v1.3 (Dec 15 2023); authors Campbell-Thompson, Eskaros, Saunders; Data DOI https://doi.org/10.48539/HBM336.TBNP.923
asctb.note: Header on line 11 (1-based), 10 metadata lines before it. Gene IDs are HGNC. All REF/* columns are empty for every row, so no per-row DOIs; table-level literature is in the General Publication(s) metadata line (Walker et al. 2021 doi:10.1210/endrev/bnab010 and a list of RNAseq PMIDs).

hpa.method: Lists were computed from the bulk TSV (same data as the API). Ranking rule: by nCPM in the named cell type among genes HPA classifies as Cell type enriched / Group enriched / Cell type enhanced (single-cell lists), or by the rules stated in each basis field.

method: ASCT+B: biomarkers are copied from the rows where the cell type is the deepest term of the chain (labels from *LABEL columns, ids HGNC). Genes on rows where it is a parent term are listed apart under asctb.related.

HPA: HPA single-cell data for pancreas has only acinar, duct and (lumped) islet cells. Each gene states the basis on which it was chosen; endothelial, stellate and red-cell lists are cross-tissue, not pancreas-specific.
